question: Is Khum Raksa Maojai Extra Bronze's ฿30,000 deductible one amount for the entire year, or per inpatient admission? Does it apply to every benefit?
answer:
The THB 30,000 deductible applies per inpatient admission, not once for the entire year. It applies to benefits 1–6 subject to the printed exceptions: benefit 2.1 (outpatient medical expenses); benefit 2.2, minor surgery ONLY; benefit 3.1 (specified critical-illness lump sum); benefit 6.1 (emergency outpatient treatment). Only the minor-surgery part of benefit 2.2 is listed as an exception; do not exempt the entire day-surgery benefit or reverse this into excluding minor surgery from the exception. It does not apply to every benefit. Full policy and claim conditions still apply.
